lich/01: A complete floating ivory skeleton catches small diamond-like spectral glints along sunlit bone edges.
lich/02: A complete floating skeleton of translucent quartz refracts the cave's sunlight into small internal rainbows.
lich/03: A floating milky opal skeleton shows localized play-of-colour flashes where the warm sunlight strikes.
lich/04: A floating pearly skeleton has a soft pink-green-blue nacre sheen on its sunlit bone surfaces.
lich/05: A white floating skeleton reveals faint spectral colour inside thin ribs and fingers through transmitted sunlight.
lich/06: A floating skeleton of subtly faceted pale gem bone catches distinct spectral flashes on small sun-facing facets.
lich/07: A complete opal skeleton straddles the shaft of sunlight, with spectral flashes on its lit half and quiet pale bone in shadow.
lich/08: A close photographic view of an opal skull and shoulders contrasts sunlit play-of-colour with dim pale bone.
snake/01: A reticulated python emerges across rough cave stone, its complete patterned body trailing behind a slightly raised head.
snake/02: A dark Burmese python approaches the light with its stout body and subdued brown saddle markings fully in frame.
snake/03: A slender grey-olive black mamba raises its elongated head above the cave floor as its full body leaves shadow.
snake/04: A king cobra approaches with its hood lowered, its dark subtly banded body visible from head to tail.
snake/05: A heavy Gaboon viper with broad horned head and geometric leaf-litter pattern rests partly in the cave's sunlight.
snake/06: An eastern diamondback rattlesnake crosses rough stone, showing cream-edged diamonds, a raised head and its complete rattle.
snake/07: A black rat snake lifts its small head into warm sunlight while its long dark body remains partly in shadow.
snake/08: A large dark boa constrictor approaches the sunlit floor with its complete saddle-marked body extending back into shadow.
cave/01: A dry cenote-like chamber receives one narrow shaft of sunlight across a rough rubble-strewn floor.
cave/02: A limestone cavern's stalagmites and uneven flowstone floor are revealed by a single sunlit pool and its soft bounce.
cave/03: One skylight sends warm sunlight into a dark basalt lava tube over rough collapsed rock.
cave/04: A shaft of sunlight grazes broken slabs and boulders in a chamber of dark fractured rock.
cave/05: A high oblique view looks about 60 degrees down into a limestone cavern at one sunlit pool among stalagmites.
cave/06: A close view reveals sparse dust in a warm sunlight shaft above sharply textured illuminated stone and grit.
